name: Chef Jessen
summary: In Southshore, Chef Jessen keeps the town fed while the borders remain tense. His turtle bisque is famous.

sections.title: A Cook in Southshore
sections.body:
Chef Jessen supplies meat and provisions in Southshore, in southern Hillsbrad Foothills. Locals and visiting Alliance soldiers rely on his provisions, and he is a skilled cook.

Before plague and war disrupted northern Lordaeron, Chef Jessen often traveled north past Dalaran to the shores of Lordamere Lake. There he gathered meat from native snapjaw turtles for his Soothing Turtle Bisque. Travelers who help gather its ingredients can learn the recipe from him.

faq.answer: Chef Jessen is a human butcher and cook in Southshore, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He sells meat and shares local recipes with travelers who support the Alliance.

faq.q: What is Chef Jessen's famous dish?
faq.answer: Chef Jessen is famous for his Soothing Turtle Bisque. In years past, he gathered snapjaw turtle meat near Lordamere Lake, north past Dalaran, to make the hearty broth.

faq.q: Why does Chef Jessen ask travelers for help?
faq.answer: Gathering snapjaw turtle meat around Lordamere Lake has grown dangerous amid regional instability and the nearby Forsaken presence. Chef Jessen depends on capable travelers to gather meat for his bisque.

faq.q: Does Chef Jessen sell anything unusual?
faq.answer: Chef Jessen sells meat to the people of Southshore. He teaches his Soothing Turtle Bisque recipe to cooks who help gather snapjaw meat.

angles.text: As a cook passing through Hillsbrad, you can ask Chef Jessen for his turtle bisque recipe. It makes a substantial meal for hardy travelers.
In Southshore, Chef Jessen helps feed Alliance soldiers and adventurers holding the defensive line against northern threats.
